sections.kicker: Prepared for Hutan Hujan Beauty by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Hutan Hujan has a world. Its name for itself leaves people outside it.
sections.keep: The rainforest idea. "A ritual skincare house rooted in Indonesian biodiversity" is specific and nobody else can say it.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet

pins.what: The profile name says what the skincare is not.
pins.why: "Beyond Physical" is abstract. A new visitor learns the mood, not the product.
pins.how: Put a plain word for what you sell next to the poetic one.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: Search and first glances land on a mood, not on a skincare house.

pins.area: Founder's Diary tiles switch between lime, teal and olive backgrounds
pins.what: The Founder's Diary tiles change colour from one to the next.
pins.why: Lime, teal and olive backgrounds make the series look like three different accounts.
pins.how: Pick one background for the series and keep it.
pins.label: Your grid
pins.cost: The grid reads as scattered, and a house with a ritual should look like one.

pins.quote: it was created to become a gentle pause
pins.what: The strongest positioning line is buried in a caption.
pins.why: It says the serum is a pause, not another product, which is exactly why not the one next door.
pins.how: Move this idea to the bio and the first tile.
pins.label: Your captions
pins.cost: Most visitors never open the caption where the reason lives.
